thread:
lee-sre: Heads up - after the overnight kernel + OFED push in eu-central-1 we're seeing substantial NCCL collective throughput loss on p4dn and a100-40gb hosts. Noticed around 01:10 UTC.

toni-infra: How big is the regression? any perf numbers?

lee-sre: Quick numbers from a 8-node nccl-tests all-reduce: before patch ~92 GB/s aggregate, after patch ~41 GB/s. Latency for small msgs also spiked.

anya-ml: Yikes. Which bits moved in the rollout? kernel/CUDA/OFED/firmware?

lee-sre: Rollout details: kernel 5.15 -> 6.1.12, MLNX_OFED 5.9-2.3.0 applied, NIC firmware bumped to 22.40.8000. NVIDIA driver/containers unchanged for these hosts.

noah-eng: Any kernel logs on the bad hosts? link events, MCA errors?

lee-sre: dmesg shows repeated mlx5 async events and port state changes, plus "mlx5_core: CQ timeout detected" on a couple nodes. Example snippet:

```
[   23.456789] mlx5_core 0000:81:00.0: async event: port state change to 1
[   23.456792] mlx5_core 0000:81:00.0: mlx5_vdpa_attach: failed -16
[   27.123456] mlx5_core 0000:81:00.0: CQ 512 hung, resetting
```

toni-infra: Does ibv_devinfo show any device attribute changes? Are link speeds negotiated differently?

lee-sre: ibv_devinfo reports same link speed but `ib_read_bw` shows packet loss and retransmits during the run. Sockets/RDMA shows higher retries.

anya-ml: Is this region-only? I can check model jobs scheduled in eu-central-1.

lee-sre: So far limited to eu-central-1. us-west-2 and eu-west-1 not affected. The rollout was region-limited.

noah-eng: Can we try unloading mlx5 and reloading to see if it recovers? maybe it's driver/firmware handshake ordering.

lee-sre: Tried module reload on one host: `modprobe -r mlx5_core mlx5_ib mlx5_vdpa` then `modprobe mlx5_core`. Ports came back but NCCL perf still ~60% of baseline until reboot. Rebooting node fully restores perf.

deploy-bot: deploy: kernel-6.1.12 + MLNX_OFED-2.3.0 rolled to eu-central-1 canary at 00:45 UTC, expanded to additional hosts at 00:55 UTC.

toni-infra: Reboots fix the node temporarily, but we can't reboot entire cluster. Suggest pausing the expansion and pinning affected instance profiles to previous image. Open an incident so we can track rollback/contacts.

lee-sre: Opening incident INF-2026-420 and pausing further expansion now.

anya-ml: Also let's add a pre-expansion smoke test: 4-node nccl allreduce plus ib_read_bw checks (with retry thresholds) in the deployment pipeline.

noah-eng: I'll collect `ethtool -i`, `modinfo mlx5_core`, and full `dmesg` for a few hosts and open a vendor ticket with Mellanox/AWS. Include the before/after nccl-tests outputs.

vendor-bot: ticket created: VEND-7782 with priority P1 - awaiting vendor triage. Please attach logs and perf traces.

lee-sre: Mitigation plan: 1) stop expansion and pin image for p4dn/a100-40gb in eu-central-1, 2) limit new allocation to unaffected regions, 3) vendor ticket + escalate to AWS if firmware rollback needed, 4) add RDMA/NCCL smoke to rollout gates.

toni-infra: Approved. Add cost note: keeping pinned older images may delay security/driver updates and has a small increased risk/cost — include in incident estimate.

anya-ml: On the ML side, we'll reschedule critical long-running training to other regions where possible. Also adding alerting for >30% drop in aggregate NCCL throughput per region.

noah-eng: FYI I also saw subtle differences in IRQ balancing after kernel change. I'll test with irqaffinity off on a couple hosts to rule that out.

lee-sre: Thanks all. If you find a host with both high CQ resets and firmware 22.40.8000 tag, please mark it in the incident channel with `#INF-2026-420` so we can prioritize.

-- end of thread --
